summary: The Reconciliation section states one reconciliation mechanism: a nightly job compares ledger totals to the bank feed and opens a ticket on mismatch. The rest is heavily repeated boilerplate about operations: structured logs with request ids, low-priority backfills, per-region dashboards, schema review for index impact, health/readiness endpoints, ninety-day secret rotation, sub-200 ms p95 read latency, single YAML config, alerts paging after five minutes, and a three-phase zero-downtime migration.

claims.text: A nightly job compares ledger totals against the bank feed and opens a ticket on any mismatch.
Every write path emits a structured log line with the request id.
Latency targets stay under 200 ms at the 95th percentile for reads.
Alerts route to the payments channel and page after five minutes.
Secrets rotate every ninety days through the platform vault.
The migration ran in three phases over two weekends without downtime.

risks.note: 200 ms p95 read target stated with no measurement or source.
Zero-downtime three-phase migration asserted with no evidence or date.
Paragraphs 71-81 repeat the same sentences many times; filler, no reconciliation detail beyond line 69.

least_confident: I could not check whether the reconciliation job's mismatch handling (ticket only, no auto-correction or alert) matches other sections, since line 69 is the only substantive reconciliation sentence.
